title: APC Back-UPS Pro BR700G 700VA Tower UPS
subtitle: 700VA / 420W | 6 outlets | AVR | LCD | User-replaceable battery
description: Compact battery backup for home and small-office electronics, with automatic voltage regulation, an LCD showing load and battery levels, data-line surge protection and a battery the user can swap. Specifications verified against Schneider Electric's official APC product page.

specs.label: Display
specs.value: LCD with load and battery bar graphs

highlights: LCD with load and battery bar graphs
review_notes: Spec source is the US (120V) BR700G page; the Commons photo is labelled BR700G-TW, the Taiwan SKU of the same Back-UPS Pro 700 (Taiwan also uses 110-120V NEMA outlets). Spec table on se.com is script-rendered; specs taken from the title and feature bullets.
